purpose: Close the V0 photo-to-avatar multi-view QA gate with one rights-cleared owned product of known physical scale.

capture_requirements.subject: one stationary opaque product with visually distinct features and no transparent or highly reflective dominant surfaces
capture_requirements.background: plain, non-reflective and visually separated from the object
capture_requirements.lighting: soft, even and fixed across views; avoid moving cast shadows
capture_requirements.camera: fixed focal length where possible; keep the full object in frame
capture_requirements.overlap: capture additional orbit frames for QA even though the Meshy generation request uses at most four inputs
capture_requirements.scale: measure width, depth and height in millimetres and photograph or reference the measurement evidence

rights_requirements.source: user-owned capture or another source explicitly cleared for reconstruction
rights_requirements.redistribution_allowed: may remain no; generated output then stays ephemeral

reconstruction.credential_policy: secret only; never place the key in a job file, chat message, metric or Git

input_policy.image_references: temporary HTTPS URLs readable by the reconstruction service

required_qa: source-view silhouette and landmark rerender comparison
observed, inferred and unresolved surface percentages totalling 100
rights review before any generated-asset publication
